text: To advocate environmental sustainability and support basic education in impoverished rural areas, our university is launching a campus-wide book donation campaign titled Pass on the Light of Knowledge.
We warmly welcome all students and faculty members to donate unused books, particularly academic references, literary classics, and popular science works.
Please ensure that the books are clean and complete.
Collection stations will be set up at the lobby of the Central Library and Student Activity Center from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. this coming weekend.
Every donated book delivers a ray of hope to children in need.
Let us join hands to share our wisdom and foster social harmony!
